card.text: M75 is a globular star cluster in the Milky Way, about 20,520 parsecs away.

sources.label: Baumgardt & Vasiliev (2021), Accurate distances to Galactic globular clusters through a combination of Gaia EDR3, HST and literature data, MNRAS 505, 5957; Baumgardt's orbits table, NGC_6864: Rsun 20.52 ± 0.45 kpc
Wikipedia, "Messier 75"
sources.quote: Messier 75 or M75, also known as NGC 6864, is a globular cluster of stars in the southern constellation Sagittarius.

introduction.text: M75 is drawn as 279 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
